title: Grateful Dead Live at O'Keefe Center on 1967-08-05
source: (Reel to Reel?) > 8-Track Tape > Zenith 8-Track Player (anaologe out) > Digital Input / Protools Capture > 15H kps / 48 kHz .wav file > Flac

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a historic show with the debut of TIFTOO and a standout Morning Dew
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this rare recording, noting it appears to be the long‑sought missing material from August 5, 1967. The performance is highlighted by the first known outing of TIFTOO and an inspired rendition of Morning Dew, plus plenty of engaging banter that makes the set feel intimate.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave five‑star ratings and praised the show’s historic moments; no recording complaints were noted, suggesting a high‑quality soundboard source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific issues mentioned; reviewers’ enthusiasm implies clear and balanced audio.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is praised for its lively banter and the inclusion of a rare debut, creating an engaging and memorable flow.
